title: David organizes the Levites
description: When David was old and had made Solomon king, he gathered the leaders of Israel, the priests and the Levites to organize the service at the house of the Lord. The Levites were counted from thirty years of age and totaled 38,000 men, who were assigned as overseers, supervisors and judges, gatekeepers and singers with instruments. David divided them according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari, and appointed the heads of their families. Since the Lord had given rest to the people in Jerusalem and the tabernacle no longer needed to be carried, the service age was lowered to twenty years. The Levites were to assist Aaron's sons with the courtyards, the showbread, measures and weights, and to praise the Lord morning and evening. [ref:1 Chr 23:1-32|1 Chronicles 23:1-32]
